title: hotfix: SLO enforcement + circuit-breaker load-shedding fallback (regional failover stabilization)
author: Aisha Kumar
description:
Context: During the 2026-02-17 incident we observed sustained latency spikes and cascading CPU/GPU queue buildup in the eu-west region. Root cause analysis showed the SLO enforcer was not shedding load early enough because the policy used instant rate-based thresholds rather than sustained-p95 windows, and the circuit-breaker logic allowed requests to retry into overloaded pools. In some cases regional failover would choose a model variant that did not support the required kv-cache affinity, causing additional errors.

What this PR does: Implements a hotfix to improve SLO enforcement and graceful degradation across the serving stack. Changes are conservative and feature-flagged for immediate rollout.

Key changes:
- SLO enforcer: switch evaluation from instantaneous latency to a rolling p95 window (configurable, default 60s) and apply error-budget-aware shed weight. This allows earlier, smoother shedding before queues saturate.
- Circuit breaker: tighten tripping logic to consider sustained queue length + backend error-rate; add a short cooldown and randomized retry jitter to avoid thundering herds.
- Load-shedding strategy: add a prioritized shedding policy (best-effort -> cached prefixes -> low-priority models) and ensure shed decisions are exposed to metrics/traces for playback.
- Regional failover: fix variant compatibility check so failovers pick compatible kv-cache/model variants and add a fallback to cross-region stateless pool when necessary.
- Tests and harness: add deterministic unit tests and an e2e load simulation config used during the incident replay.
- Docs: incident runbook updated with new mitigation steps and feature-flag rollback instructions.

Rollout plan:
- Feature flag default: off in main. Toggle on eu-west first (observability dashboard monitored), then gradual rollout to global regions.
- Monitor: p95 latency, queue length, error-rate, shed-count, and model-variant-fallbacks. Alert thresholds documented in the runbook.

Checklist:
- [x] Add SLO p95 window and error-budget integration
- [x] Tighten circuit-breaker tripping and add jittered retry cooldown
- [x] Implement prioritized load-shedding policy
- [x] Fix regional variant compatibility check
- [x] Add unit + e2e harness + CI coverage
- [x] Update incident runbook and release notes

Notes: This PR is intentionally scoped to runtime and routing changes only; it avoids large refactors to enable quick verification in production. Related Linear items: ENG-4982 (primary), ENG-4931 (follow-ups).
